github.subtitle: Manage the GitHub Apps that connect repositories to projects

callback.manifestError: Could not create the GitHub App. The code has expired or was already used. Try again.

masterKey.title: Master key is not configured
masterKey.body: GitHub App credentials must be encrypted before they are stored in the database. Set {file} to a file containing a 32-byte key (base64), then restart the Control API.
masterKey.bodyShort: GitHub App credentials must be encrypted before they are stored. Set {file} on the server, then restart the Control API.
masterKey.detailsLink: See details in GitHub Apps settings

apps.createIntro: Zixploy creates the GitHub App for you. GitHub asks you to confirm, then sends the credentials back (stored encrypted, no need to copy a key yourself).
apps.name: App name
apps.nameHint: {n}/34. The name must not match any other App on GitHub.
apps.emptyHint: Create your first app to connect a repository
apps.notInstalled: Not installed on any account yet
apps.deleteMessage: This removes the app from Zixploy. Its installations are disconnected and auto deploy is turned off for the related projects. The app still exists on GitHub and must be deleted in GitHub settings.

error.nameTooLong: The app name must be 34 characters or fewer (GitHub limit)
error.installUrl: Could not create the install URL

connect.createHint: Create an app in settings to connect a repository
connect.askAdmin: Ask an admin to create and install a GitHub App before you connect a repository
connect.notInstalled: A GitHub App exists but is not installed on any account yet

picker.noApps: No GitHub App is installed yet. Create and install one in settings first.
picker.suspended: This GitHub installation is suspended. Unsuspend it in the GitHub App settings first.
picker.noRepos: No accessible repositories. Check the GitHub App permissions.
